aliases.$comment: Cursor event list prices reported in #1229 track Grok 4.6 Fast for default and base for automation. grok-bot-cua stays unaliased until its own rates are confirmed.

Antigravity internal IDs for Gemini 3.1 Pro: gemini-pro-agent is the High-effort wire ID (pi-antigravity routing table, OmniRoute#3696) and gemini-pro-default is the CLI's label when the picker is on its default, which resolves to Gemini 3.1 Pro (High) via the display label; the slug alone covers records without one. gemini-default is deliberately unaliased: its label has pointed at 3.5 Flash and 3.6 Flash over time.
